profile.name: Huixuan Zhang
profile.bio: I study generative AI and computer vision, with a focus on text-to-image diffusion models, image–text alignment, and the evaluation and detection of AI-generated images.

publications.title: R-Bind: Unified Enhancement of Attribute and Relation Binding in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
publications.description: An inference-time method for improving attribute and relation binding in text-to-image diffusion models.

publications.title: Image Matters: A New Dataset and Empirical Study for Multimodal Hyperbole Detection
publications.description: A dataset and empirical study on identifying hyperbole using both text and images.
